verdict.rationale: Heap publishes a per-endpoint API reference at developers.heap.io/reference, covering track, bulk track, identify, account properties and user deletion, with machine-readable llms.txt and .md versions. Nothing in the evidence shows that reference is interactive or offers runnable 'try it' examples, and all probed OpenAPI spec paths returned 404. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console, runnable code examples, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
